label: Any two actual CONCRETE_6 roots of the selected grounding relation at w are the same
paraphrase: For any x and y: if each is an actual concrete root of the selected grounding relation at w (concrete, existing at w, with no actual concrete ground at w; NecessaryRootFork.ActualRoot), then x and y are the same. Only 'at most one': no root is said to exist, and nothing is said about necessity, uniqueness among necessary beings or God identification.
